Name: Vibrant Harvest Green and Sunrise Blue Tropical Furniture by Dracofly1192
Author: glymr
Description:
A conversion of Dracofly1192's Vibrant Furniture for use with Alternative Textures and 1.6. Both Harvest Green and Sunrise Blue furniture versions are included. Created with permission. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29525]The matching tropical harvest green kitchen is here[/url]﻿. To use this mod, install Alternative Textures, purchase the paint can from Robin, and use it on your farmhouse furniture to convert it to the vibrant version. Includes kitchen counters that match with the kitchen for use on Ginger Island.

Special thanks to Lumisteria who granted permission for her toddler sprites to be used in this updated version of the original mod.

If you like this mod, it would make us very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!
